items.example: The secretary called the proceedings a farce.
items.cloze: The secretary called the proceedings a ______.
items.analysis_zh: farce 可用来批评某一程序缺乏严肃性。
items.why_zh: farce 可用来批评某一程序缺乏严肃性。

items.example: The accusations concerned military decisions, among other things.
items.analysis_zh: among other things 可放在句末，为新闻信息留出概括空间。
items.cloze: The accusations concerned military decisions, ______.
items.hint_zh: 用于概括列举但未穷尽的事项。
items.why_zh: among other things 可放在句末，为新闻信息留出概括空间。

items.example: The firm hopes to raise as much as $64bn through its listing.
items.analysis_zh: 在金额前用 as much as 引出上限，避免误读为确定融资金额。
items.cloze: The firm hopes to raise ______ $64bn through its listing.
items.hint_zh: 常用于强调大额上限，注意与 as many as 的可数差别。
items.why_zh: 在金额前用 as much as 引出上限，避免误读为确定融资金额。

items.example: House Republicans blocked an impeachment attempt.
items.analysis_zh: blocked an attempt 体现程序性阻止。
items.cloze: House Republicans ______ an impeachment attempt.
items.hint_zh: 结构：block an attempt to do something。
items.why_zh: blocked an attempt 体现程序性阻止。

items.meaning_zh: 关键爆发点（came to a head）
items.example: The dispute came to a head after the suspension.
items.analysis_zh: come to a head 描述长期矛盾到达临界点。
items.cloze: The dispute came to a ______ after the suspension.
items.hint_zh: 使用过去式 came；突出长期累积的矛盾到了临界点。
items.why_zh: come to a head 描述长期矛盾到达临界点。

items.example: Authorities said they would carry out the sentence.
items.cloze: Authorities said they would ______ out the sentence.
items.analysis_zh: carry out the sentence 中 carry 与 out 构成执行判决的动词短语。
items.why_zh: carry out the sentence 中 carry 与 out 构成执行判决的动词短语。

items.example: Police clashed with protesters at the rallies.
items.analysis_zh: clash with 描述示威者、警方或群体之间的冲突。
items.cloze: Police ______ with protesters at the rallies.
items.why_zh: clash with 描述示威者、警方或群体之间的冲突。

items.example: The ruling concerned consensual relations between adults.
items.analysis_zh: consensual 强调行为在自愿和同意基础上发生，常见于法律新闻。
items.cloze: The ruling concerned ______ relations between adults.
items.why_zh: consensual 强调行为在自愿和同意基础上发生，常见于法律新闻。

items.example: The court overturned laws criminalising consensual acts.
items.analysis_zh: criminalise 在法律报道中表示将某种行为纳入刑事处罚。
items.cloze: The court overturned laws ______ consensual acts.
items.why_zh: criminalise 在法律报道中表示将某种行为纳入刑事处罚。

items.example: Opposition parties denounced the suspension.
items.cloze: Opposition parties ______ the suspension.
items.analysis_zh: denounce 强于 criticise，指公开强烈谴责。
items.why_zh: denounce 强于 criticise，指公开强烈谴责。

items.example: The talks did little to halt the fighting.
items.analysis_zh: did little to do 表示对结果帮助有限；此处只挖 little，保留结构。
items.cloze: The talks did ______ to halt the fighting.
items.hint_zh: 后接动词原形，表示对某种结果影响有限。
items.why_zh: did little to do 表示对结果帮助有限；此处只挖 little，保留结构。

items.example: Higher rents have eroded household purchasing power.
items.analysis_zh: erode 用于形容生活水平、利润率和信心逐渐受损。
items.cloze: Higher rents have ______ household purchasing power.
items.hint_zh: 描述生活水平或利润率逐渐受损，语气比 destroyed 更符合经济报道。
items.why_zh: erode 用于形容生活水平、利润率和信心逐渐受损。

items.example: The rules violated fundamental rights.
items.cloze: The rules violated ______ rights.
items.analysis_zh: fundamental rights 是法律报道的常见搭配。
items.why_zh: fundamental rights 是法律报道的常见搭配。

items.example: Unions declared a general strike.
items.cloze: Unions declared a ______ strike.
items.analysis_zh: general strike 指跨行业大规模罢工。
items.why_zh: general strike 指跨行业大规模罢工。

items.example: The talks covered humanitarian concerns.
items.analysis_zh: humanitarian issues 表示与人道主义援助、人员安全等相关议题。
items.cloze: The talks covered ______ concerns.
items.why_zh: humanitarian issues 表示与人道主义援助、人员安全等相关议题。

items.example: Republicans blocked a motion to impeach the minister.
items.analysis_zh: impeach 指发起正式弹劾程序。
items.cloze: Republicans blocked a motion to ______ the minister.
items.why_zh: impeach 指发起正式弹劾程序。

items.meaning_zh: 缺席（法律拉丁语表达中）
items.example: She was sentenced in absentia.
items.analysis_zh: in absentia 表示在被告缺席的情况下作出裁决。
items.cloze: She was sentenced in ______.
items.hint_zh: 法律报道的拉丁语表达，表示被告本人没有出庭。
items.why_zh: in absentia 表示在被告缺席的情况下作出裁决。

items.example: The country was on edge before the holiday.
items.cloze: The country was on ______ before the holiday.
items.analysis_zh: on edge 描述紧张不安的持续状态。
items.why_zh: on edge 描述紧张不安的持续状态。

items.example: The appeals court overturned the laws.
items.analysis_zh: overturned 法律报道常用于撤销下级裁决或法律条款。
items.cloze: The appeals court ______ the laws.
items.hint_zh: 用于较高级别法院推翻先前决定。
items.why_zh: overturned 法律报道常用于撤销下级裁决或法律条款。

items.example: The company pursued a private allocation of shares.
items.analysis_zh: private allocation of shares 是融资安排，重点记忆 allocation。
items.cloze: The company pursued a private ______ of shares.
items.hint_zh: 金融新闻中的 allocation 可以指股份配售。
items.why_zh: private allocation of shares 是融资安排，重点记忆 allocation。

items.example: The rallies were prompted by her planned return.
items.analysis_zh: prompted by 表示事件由某个因素直接触发。
items.cloze: The rallies were ______ by her planned return.
items.hint_zh: 被动结构后接名词，突出事件触发因素。
items.why_zh: prompted by 表示事件由某个因素直接触发。

items.example: Rates might increase by more than a quarter-point.
items.cloze: Rates might increase by more than ______.
items.analysis_zh: 利率报道常用 quarter-point 表示 0.25 个百分点。
items.why_zh: 利率报道常用 quarter-point 表示 0.25 个百分点。

items.example: Traders reckon the bank may raise rates.
items.analysis_zh: reckon 常用于报道交易员对利率趋势的判断。
items.cloze: Traders ______ the bank may raise rates.
items.why_zh: reckon 常用于报道交易员对利率趋势的判断。

items.example: The court called the ban a relic of colonial rule.
items.cloze: The court called the ban a ______ of colonial rule.
items.analysis_zh: relic 强调制度是历史遗留下来的。
items.why_zh: relic 强调制度是历史遗留下来的。

items.example: Bankers are reportedly considering a higher valuation.
items.analysis_zh: reportedly 表示报道归因，避免把传闻直接写为事实。
items.cloze: Bankers are ______ considering a higher valuation.
items.hint_zh: 副词修饰整句，表明信息来自报道而非已经核实的事实。
items.why_zh: reportedly 表示报道归因，避免把传闻直接写为事实。

items.example: The president described the meeting as substantive.
items.analysis_zh: substantive 指讨论内容有实质内容；表示评价而非最终结果。
items.cloze: The president described the meeting as ______.
items.hint_zh: 表示会谈涉及实质议题，比 productive 更审慎。
items.why_zh: substantive 指讨论内容有实质内容；表示评价而非最终结果。

items.example: Prices rose, surpassing expectations.
items.analysis_zh: surpassing 表示实际指标超出市场预期。
items.cloze: Prices rose, ______ expectations.
items.hint_zh: 现在分词作补充信息，浓缩与市场预测的比较。
items.why_zh: surpassing 表示实际指标超出市场预期。

items.example: The court president was suspended after the dispute.
items.analysis_zh: suspended 可表示被停职、资格被暂时中止。
items.cloze: The court president was ______ after the dispute.
items.why_zh: suspended 可表示被停职、资格被暂时中止。

items.example: The administration announced sweeping tariffs.
items.analysis_zh: sweeping 在新闻中修饰影响范围很广的措施。
items.cloze: The administration announced ______ tariffs.
items.hint_zh: sweeping 强调范围广、影响大。
items.why_zh: sweeping 在新闻中修饰影响范围很广的措施。

items.example: The governing party is trailing behind its rivals.
items.cloze: The governing party is ______ behind its rivals.
items.analysis_zh: trailing behind 在民调、竞赛等语境形容落后。
items.why_zh: trailing behind 在民调、竞赛等语境形容落后。

items.example: Diplomats resumed trilateral talks.
items.analysis_zh: trilateral 修饰 talks，强调三方参加。
items.cloze: Diplomats resumed ______ talks.
items.hint_zh: 由 tri（三）和 lateral（方的）构成，概括三方参与的外交谈判。
items.why_zh: trilateral 修饰 talks，强调三方参加。

items.example: The firm is preparing for its upcoming IPO.
items.analysis_zh: upcoming 修饰即将发生的事件，常搭配 IPO、election、meeting。
items.cloze: The firm is preparing for its ______ IPO.
items.why_zh: upcoming 修饰即将发生的事件，常搭配 IPO、election、meeting。

items.example: Investors questioned the firm's valuation.
items.cloze: Investors questioned the firm's ______.
items.analysis_zh: valuation 与实际募集资金规模有区别。
items.why_zh: valuation 与实际募集资金规模有区别。

items.example: The walkout was triggered by anger over housing costs.
items.analysis_zh: walkout 指集体停工或离岗，常见于劳资争议新闻。
items.cloze: The ______ was triggered by anger over housing costs.
items.why_zh: walkout 指集体停工或离岗，常见于劳资争议新闻。

items.example: Treasury yields rose after the inflation report.
items.analysis_zh: Treasury yields 指美国国债收益率，财经新闻高频搭配。
items.cloze: Treasury ______ rose after the inflation report.
items.why_zh: Treasury yields 指美国国债收益率，财经新闻高频搭配。

items.example: Reports of his personal relationships raised questions about governance, and directors considered whether he might be ousted.
items.analysis_zh: 用于描述领导者可能被董事会或政治力量撤换。
items.cloze: Reports of his personal relationships raised questions about governance, and directors considered whether he might be ______.
items.why_zh: 用于描述领导者可能被董事会或政治力量撤换。

items.example: Investors reacted sharply, with the company's shares plunging in after-hours trading.
items.analysis_zh: 描述股价短时间内急剧下跌。
items.cloze: Investors reacted sharply, with the company's shares ______ in after-hours trading.
items.why_zh: 描述股价短时间内急剧下跌。

items.example: Speculation then turned to the finance chief as a possible interim leader, although replacing a long-serving founder-like figure would be exceptionally difficult.
items.analysis_zh: 用于任命正式继任者前的过渡职务。
items.cloze: Speculation then turned to the finance chief as a possible ______ leader, although replacing a long-serving founder-like figure would be exceptionally difficult.
items.why_zh: 用于任命正式继任者前的过渡职务。

items.example: The uncertainty also rattled a business central to the artificial-intelligence boom.
items.analysis_zh: 强调丑闻冲击公司或市场信心。
items.cloze: The uncertainty also ______ a business central to the artificial-intelligence boom.
items.why_zh: 强调丑闻冲击公司或市场信心。

items.example: Shares in several American and Chinese rivals surged as traders reconsidered which companies might benefit from the upheaval.
items.analysis_zh: 市场报道常用，表示价格快速上升。
items.cloze: Shares in several American and Chinese rivals ______ as traders reconsidered which companies might benefit from the upheaval.
items.why_zh: 市场报道常用，表示价格快速上升。

items.example: Meanwhile, a cloud-computing provider that rents specialist AI processors reported stronger earnings than analysts had anticipated.
items.analysis_zh: rents out 指向客户出租设备或算力。
items.cloze: Meanwhile, a cloud-computing provider that ______ specialist AI processors reported stronger earnings than analysts had anticipated.
items.hint_zh: 搭配：rents out specialist AI chips
items.why_zh: rents out 指向客户出租设备或算力。

items.example: Its results beat expectations and helped lift sentiment across parts of the technology sector.
items.analysis_zh: 财报中常见搭配，指业绩高于预期。
items.cloze: Its results ______ expectations and helped lift sentiment across parts of the technology sector.
items.why_zh: 财报中常见搭配，指业绩高于预期。

items.example: The divergent moves showed how quickly investors can shift their bets within the AI industry.
items.analysis_zh: 描述投资者重新配置押注方向。
items.cloze: The divergent moves showed how quickly investors can ______ their bets within the AI industry.
items.why_zh: 描述投资者重新配置押注方向。

items.example: Britain's economy expanded in the third quarter, bolstered by household demand and business spending on artificial intelligence.
items.analysis_zh: 解释增长受到什么因素支持。
items.cloze: Britain's economy expanded in the third quarter, ______ by household demand and business spending on artificial intelligence.
items.why_zh: 解释增长受到什么因素支持。

items.example: September's output also increased, despite warnings that higher energy costs were beginning to bite.
items.analysis_zh: 形容成本或政策压力开始产生实际痛感。
items.cloze: September's output also increased, despite warnings that higher energy costs were beginning to ______.
items.why_zh: 形容成本或政策压力开始产生实际痛感。

items.example: The chancellor cited the figures as evidence of economic resilience.
items.analysis_zh: 经济新闻中评价逆境下保持增长的能力。
items.cloze: The chancellor cited the figures as evidence of economic ______.
items.why_zh: 经济新闻中评价逆境下保持增长的能力。

items.example: Yet the Bank of England had raised interest rates to contain inflation, and analysts worried that tighter credit could weaken growth later in the year.
items.analysis_zh: 描述利率和成本对增长的负面作用。
items.cloze: Yet the Bank of England had raised interest rates to contain inflation, and analysts worried that tighter credit could ______ growth later in the year.
items.why_zh: 描述利率和成本对增长的负面作用。

items.example: Officials said the measures would target banks and other organisations linked to the country's war effort.
items.analysis_zh: 说明制裁或政策直接针对的对象。
items.cloze: Officials said the measures would ______ banks and other organisations linked to the country's war effort.
items.why_zh: 说明制裁或政策直接针对的对象。

items.example: The wider purpose was to disrupt financial activity and counter hybrid operations, including misinformation campaigns.
items.analysis_zh: 比普通的 affect 更强调干扰正常运作。
items.cloze: The wider purpose was to ______ financial activity and counter hybrid operations, including misinformation campaigns.
items.why_zh: 比普通的 affect 更强调干扰正常运作。

items.example: France's European-affairs minister said further sanctions would be applied the following week.
items.analysis_zh: 说明制裁正式实施。
items.cloze: France's European-affairs minister said further sanctions would be ______ the following week.
items.why_zh: 说明制裁正式实施。

items.example: The package illustrated the bloc's continuing effort to pressure Moscow while diplomacy over Ukraine remained uncertain.
items.analysis_zh: 动词用法，指通过政策措施施加压力。
items.cloze: The package illustrated the bloc's continuing effort to ______ Moscow while diplomacy over Ukraine remained uncertain.
items.why_zh: 动词用法，指通过政策措施施加压力。

items.example: Demonstrators took to the streets to demand action on an increasingly severe housing crisis.
items.analysis_zh: 比 ask for 更强烈，常用于抗议报道。
items.cloze: Demonstrators took to the streets to ______ action on an increasingly severe housing crisis.
items.why_zh: 比 ask for 更强烈，常用于抗议报道。

items.example: Some protests turned confrontational, and clashes broke out in major cities.
items.analysis_zh: 固定搭配 break out 描述冲突突然发生。
items.cloze: Some protests turned confrontational, and clashes ______ out in major cities.
items.why_zh: 固定搭配 break out 描述冲突突然发生。

items.meaning_zh: 提前举行的；临时决定的
items.example: The prime minister had called snap elections after parliament failed to pass his proposed housing reforms.
items.analysis_zh: 英国政治新闻常见表达，指提前选举。
items.cloze: The prime minister had called ______ elections after parliament failed to pass his proposed housing reforms.
items.why_zh: 英国政治新闻常见表达，指提前选举。

items.example: The unrest underscored how deeply the cost of housing had become entangled with national politics.
items.analysis_zh: 用于指出事件揭示的深层问题。
items.cloze: The unrest ______ how deeply the cost of housing had become entangled with national politics.
items.why_zh: 用于指出事件揭示的深层问题。

items.example: Ukraine's president warned that its armed forces were again experiencing patchy satellite internet connections.
items.analysis_zh: 描述网络或服务覆盖不稳定。
items.cloze: Ukraine's president warned that its armed forces were again experiencing ______ satellite internet connections.
items.why_zh: 描述网络或服务覆盖不稳定。

items.example: The interruptions were hampering systems used to intercept hostile drones, adding to pressure on the military.
items.analysis_zh: 新闻中表示某问题削弱行动效率。
items.cloze: The interruptions were ______ systems used to intercept hostile drones, adding to pressure on the military.
items.why_zh: 新闻中表示某问题削弱行动效率。

items.example: Separately, Russia and Ukraine agreed to a major prisoner exchange, providing a limited humanitarian opening.
items.analysis_zh: 指冲突双方交换被俘人员。
items.cloze: Separately, Russia and Ukraine agreed to a major prisoner ______, providing a limited humanitarian opening.
items.why_zh: 指冲突双方交换被俘人员。

items.example: American envoys travelled to Moscow to discuss possible terms for peace, although a lasting deal remained uncertain.
items.analysis_zh: 指经谈判达成的协议。
items.cloze: American envoys travelled to Moscow to discuss possible terms for peace, although a lasting ______ remained uncertain.
items.why_zh: 指经谈判达成的协议。

items.example: United Airlines announced that personal AI agents would be banned from using its online platforms.
items.analysis_zh: 用于明确禁止进入或使用某平台。
items.cloze: United Airlines announced that personal AI agents would be ______ from using its online platforms.
items.why_zh: 用于明确禁止进入或使用某平台。

items.example: The company cited the risk of data-privacy violations when autonomous software books tickets or checks passengers in.
items.analysis_zh: 表示违反隐私保护规定。
items.cloze: The company cited the risk of data-privacy ______ when autonomous software books tickets or checks passengers in.
items.why_zh: 表示违反隐私保护规定。

items.example: Such third-party bots would therefore be unable to transact on travellers' behalf through the airline's systems.
items.analysis_zh: 正式商业用语，指执行购买或付款交易。
items.cloze: Such third-party bots would therefore be unable to ______ on travellers' behalf through the airline's systems.
items.why_zh: 正式商业用语，指执行购买或付款交易。

items.example: Amazon has also restricted automated agents on its shopping site, although its leadership has suggested that the policy could change.
items.analysis_zh: 强调限制权限或使用范围。
items.cloze: Amazon has also ______ automated agents on its shopping site, although its leadership has suggested that the policy could change.
items.why_zh: 强调限制权限或使用范围。

items.example: Global appetite for matcha has risen rapidly, putting Japanese tea producers under strain.
items.analysis_zh: 表示需求增长给供应体系造成压力。
items.cloze: Global appetite for matcha has risen rapidly, putting Japanese tea producers under ______.
items.why_zh: 表示需求增长给供应体系造成压力。

items.example: Exports have expanded, but ageing farmers are retiring and the industry struggles to keep pace with demand.
items.analysis_zh: 固定搭配，表示跟上需求变化。
items.cloze: Exports have expanded, but ageing farmers are retiring and the industry struggles to keep ______ with demand.
items.why_zh: 固定搭配，表示跟上需求变化。

items.example: At an international congress in Tokyo, participants discussed quality standards and the spread of cheap counterfeits.
items.analysis_zh: 用于描述冒牌或假冒商品。
items.cloze: At an international congress in Tokyo, participants discussed quality standards and the spread of cheap ______.
items.why_zh: 用于描述冒牌或假冒商品。

items.example: Producers hope that common grading rules will help customers distinguish premium varieties from lower-cost alternatives.
items.analysis_zh: 强调识别不同品质或类别。
items.cloze: Producers hope that common grading rules will help customers ______ premium varieties from lower-cost alternatives.
items.why_zh: 强调识别不同品质或类别。

items.example: After Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia's chief executive, investors faced an abrupt leadership change.
items.analysis_zh: stepped 在新闻语境中表示“辞去职位”，结合句中搭配理解其语义。
items.cloze: After Jensen Huang ______ down as Nvidia's chief executive, investors faced an abrupt leadership change.
items.why_zh: 根据句子逻辑及搭配选择 stepped。

items.example: The company pledged large sums to AI startups and had signed major data-centre leases.
items.analysis_zh: pledged 在新闻语境中表示“承诺投入”，结合句中搭配理解其语义。
items.cloze: The company ______ large sums to AI startups and had signed major data-centre leases.
items.why_zh: 根据句子逻辑及搭配选择 pledged。

items.example: Interim boss Colette Kress must reassure partners that these deals stand.
items.analysis_zh: stand 在新闻语境中表示“继续有效”，结合句中搭配理解其语义。
items.cloze: Interim boss Colette Kress must reassure partners that these deals ______.
items.why_zh: 根据句子逻辑及搭配选择 stand。

items.example: Donald Trump told his vice-president to focus on domestic corruption allegations rather than negotiations with Iran.
items.analysis_zh: focus 在新闻语境中表示“集中精力”，结合句中搭配理解其语义。
items.cloze: Donald Trump told his vice-president to ______ on domestic corruption allegations rather than negotiations with Iran.
items.why_zh: 根据句子逻辑及搭配选择 focus。

passages.body: Officials from America, Russia and Ukraine convened for {{2026-11-11-trilateral-talks}} talks in the Gulf after a long pause in negotiations. passages.body: Nvidia's board held urgent discussions about its chief executive after fresh allegations intensified a corporate scandal. Reports of his personal relationships raised questions about governance, and directors considered whether he might be {{2026-11-12-nvidia-ousted}}. Investors reacted sharply, with the company's shares {{2026-11-12-nvidia-plunging}} in after-hours trading. passages.body: Britain's economy expanded in the third quarter, {{2026-11-12-britain-bolstered}} by household demand and business spending on artificial intelligence. The latest figures therefore offered reassurance without eliminating the risks ahead.

passages.body: Ukraine's president warned that its armed forces were again experiencing {{2026-11-12-ukraine-patchy}} satellite internet connections.
